evidence_scope: Current repository source and local fixture tests; not certification of the installed Chrome Web Store package or a live mailbox run.
architecture: DOM automation in an already-open Gmail tab in desktop Chrome; no extension OAuth, Gmail API, model API or independent network client.
scan: Discovers senders by paginating five category views, following enabled Older controls or scrolling an infinite list until it stops growing. Reads only visible conversation rows and range counters. Bounded by page guards, available DOM and scan completion.
counts: Gmail conversation/result counts, not bytes. Up to the top 250 senders are counted from Gmail results when resolvable; unresolved or sampled counts are estimates. No blanket exactness or unique-message guarantee.
action: Selected sender queries, in batches up to 20, move matching mail to Gmail Trash. Sender-wide scope includes archived matching mail; date, category, size, starred and other restrictions from a separate search are not inherited.
recovery: Ordinary Gmail Trash is normally recoverable for up to 30 days unless permanently removed sooner. No extension one-click Undo or permanent-delete capability is claimed.

separate_surfaces.website: Static hosting, external fonts and any explicit waitlist network submission are separate from the extension.
separate_surfaces.legacy_browser_app: The existing optional browser flow uses Google OAuth and Gmail API; it is not how the packaged DOM extension authenticates.
separate_surfaces.local_tools: Manual local input and output only; no mailbox scan, account authentication or automatic deletion. An explicit Open Gmail action sends the chosen search to Gmail.
